body.title: Translation policy
body.body:
Alignment pass across the `draykerdk` organization, on the branch `alinhamento/2026-09` in every affected repository.

## Changes

- docs: translation policy in the layout comment

## Across the organization

- Governance corrected: PAP is Projects & Applications, DFMP is the DFM proposal process, the founding account is `Hyadhuad`, and the governance horizon runs from the founding Embassy through the DAF into PAP.
- The veto chain specified in UID: signed, hash-linked vetoes that carry their real grounds even when anonymous; vetoes weighed by grounds, not counted; one veto with grounds beyond the decision's scope can lead to an adjustment after advanced triage.
- Direction states 2033 as the objective, measured by what works rather than by the date.
- Intelligence is a partner, never the master.
- English is the canonical documentation language.
- Documentation states its own claims and does not cite outside books as authority.

Documentation only. Nothing here claims an implemented system.

Supersedes #2, closed when the branch was renamed.

body.title: Footer: public documentation, not open source
body.body:
The shared footer of every component site said "OPEN SOURCE". It now says "PUBLIC DOCUMENTATION", matching the portal (draykerdk/drayker.org#23): the documentation is public under CC BY 4.0 and the system is auditable by permission level. Found in the final coherence check of 06/10/2026.

body.title: Load favicons from the English logo paths
body.body:
drayker.org renamed its logo files to English (draykerdk/drayker.org#46). The shared layout now loads `assets/logo/drayker-icon.svg`, `assets/logo/dark/drayker-icon.svg` and `assets/logo/kit/icon-512-dark.png`; `tools/check.js` follows. The new URLs return 200 on drayker.org, and the old paths stay there for doc sites that have not rebuilt.

Checks: `node tools/check.js` passes (25 checks).
